body:
PR #337 can apply a configured model twice for sessioned runs:
- `buildSessionSetupCommands` applies `acpx <agent> set model <id> -s <session>`.
- `buildAcpxArgs` also passes global `--model <id>` on the later prompt command.

This appears harmless or at least non-blocking today, but we should decide the intended ACPX contract:
1. Use global `--model` only for no-session exec runs, and rely on `set model` for named/transient sessions; or
2. Prove with focused coverage/docs that ACPX accepts the combined `set model` + `--model` prompt path.

Handle this alongside broader session-continuation cleanup rather than changing PR #337's current sessioned model behavior.
title: Clarify ACPX model selection for named/transient sessions
